name: smart-usage
description: Picks the reasoning effort for each prompt you send, and makes every subagent spawn name its model and effort on purpose.

mode.title: Auto effort mode
mode.description: auto applies the picked effort to the turn; suggest shows a band to apply it; off does nothing.

threshold.title: Auto effort threshold
threshold.description: Minimum probability for the picked effort before it is applied or suggested (0 to 1).

skipUnder.title: Skip follow-ups shorter than (chars)
skipUnder.description: A follow-up prompt shorter than this keeps the current effort without a new pick. 0 picks every time.

tiersFile.title: Tiers file
tiersFile.description: Absolute path to a JSON file shaped like the object in hooks/tiers.ts. Empty uses the plugin's own tiers.ts.
